operationParameters.description: Key values of the chunked snapshots stream().backfill() reads into a bronze table, kept by mssql-cdc-pyspark next to it, under its name with _snapshot_plans appended: one row per 'snapshot_open', 'snapshot_plan' and 'snapshot_chunk' row of the ingestion facts table, with that row's detail whole. The facts rows leave these values out; they are values of the source table's key, so give this table bronze's access policy.

metaData.description: Key values of the chunked snapshots stream().backfill() reads into a bronze table, kept by mssql-cdc-pyspark next to it, under its name with _snapshot_plans appended: one row per 'snapshot_open', 'snapshot_plan' and 'snapshot_chunk' row of the ingestion facts table, with that row's detail whole. The facts rows leave these values out; they are values of the source table's key, so give this table bronze's access policy.
metaData.schemaString: {"type":"struct","fields":[{"name":"snapshot","type":"string","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"The snapshot's LSN S (0x + 20 hex): min_lsn of its 'snapshot_open' facts row, and _snapshot of its rows in bronze."}},{"name":"event","type":"string","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"The facts row of the snapshot this one completes: 'snapshot_open', 'snapshot_plan' or 'snapshot_chunk' (with the chunk and wave of its detail)."}},{"name":"detail","type":"string","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"JSON, the facts row's detail with the keys it leaves out: 'snapshot_open' {mode, kind, generation, lost_from_ts, lost_to_ts, keys, plan, and switch_batch_id on one opened after a capture instance switch}, keys the columns the chunks are cut on and plan the key's extent read just after S ({kind: 'int', lo, hi, rows} for one integer key, else {kind: 'keyset', max}); 'snapshot_plan' {snapshot, kind, keys, chunk_rows, chunk_count, chunks}, chunks the [lo, hi] of every chunk in order, fixed while the snapshot is open; 'snapshot_chunk' {snapshot, chunk, wave, lo, hi, last}, the key range the chunk was read in, from lo (inclusive) to hi (exclusive). A bound is null for an open end and a list for a composite key."}}]}
